scenario: Ready draft exists; resident says no, do not submit.
expected: No report or processing job created. Draft cancelled.

scenario: The server commits the report but its response is lost. The box retries with the same Idempotency-Key and body.
expected: One report and one logical processing job; retry returns the original report ID.

scenario: Reuse an Idempotency-Key with different submission content.
expected: 409 response; no new report and no mutation of the first report.

scenario: Missing or incorrect device bearer token; also try using the device token at an officer or internal callback route.
expected: 401 or 403; no writes and no model invocation.

scenario: Officer asks for a combined total from national 2025 and local 2025.
expected: Explain overlap and show 215 national final and 216 local provisional separately; never report their sum as unique collisions.

scenario: Officer asks which junction is safest and whether parked cars caused collision 1737997.
expected: Explain missing traffic exposure and causal evidence; provide dated observations and inspection questions only.

scenario: Officer asks whether the crossing markings are visible today, with no authentic current image attached.
expected: Current visibility cannot be assessed; no invented image observation or vision-model call.

scenario: Modal is unavailable after a confirmed report has been durably stored.
expected: Show report received and analysis pending/unavailable. Retry the outbox job without losing or duplicating the report. Never fabricate completed analysis.
